display.purpose: The brief as it is typed; the largest text on the page is the user's own words.

headline.purpose: Product name in the rail, the sheet heading, the primary button.

body.purpose: Pick reasons, example briefs, select values, error text; long notes cap at 60ch.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked narrow caps for frame numbers, days live, tags, field labels, status lines, rail facts.

numeral.purpose: Handwritten rank numeral beside each pick, tilted -6deg. Never for words.

motion.name: develop
motion.purpose: Frame fades in from overexposed grey (brightness 2.4, contrast 0.4, grayscale) to the image; staggered 260ms in rank order.

motion.name: mark
motion.purpose: Grease loop draws via stroke-dashoffset after all frames develop, 220ms apart per rank; second pass trails by 40ms.

motion.name: write-in
motion.purpose: Rank numeral writes in 380ms after its loop starts, settling at rotate(-6deg).

motion.name: exposing
motion.purpose: Blank frame wells pulse between #1a1a1a and #262624 while searching, offset 120ms per frame.

motion.name: loupe
motion.purpose: Frame scales to 1.6x on hover or focus from 768px; origin inward at the strip ends.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion all develop, mark, write-in, exposing and loupe motion is removed; loops render fully drawn.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single commit action, named in the world's verb. Pressed grease at rest, grease on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 44px; min-width: 144px; padding: 0 24px; background: var(--grease-press, #c9301f); color: #fff; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; border: 0; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--grease, #e0352b); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--grease, #e0352b); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #3a3a37; color: #9a9a94; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Brief Field
components.description: Borderless display-size textarea on a 2px underline that turns grease on focus.
components.html: <label class="ds-edge-print ds-edge-amber" for="ds-brief">Brief</label><textarea id="ds-brief" class="ds-brief" rows="2" placeholder="Static for a protein bar, comparison hook against sugary snacks"></textarea>
components.css: .ds-edge-print { display: block; font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-transform: uppercase; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-edge-amber { color: var(--edge, #f2c21b); } .ds-brief { display: block; width: 100%; margin-top: 8px; padding: 0 0 12px; resize: none; background: transparent; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--rule-strong, #43433f); border-radius: 0; color: var(--proof, #e6e6e3); caret-color: var(--grease, #e0352b); font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 2.1vw, 1.75rem); line-height: 1.375; letter-spacing: -0.015em; outline: none; } .ds-brief::placeholder { color: #8d8d88; } .ds-brief:focus { border-bottom-color: var(--grease, #e0352b); }

components.name: Filter Select
components.description: Square raised-sheet select with a dim edge-print label and inline chevron.
components.html: Format
components.css: .ds-filter { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-filter-label { font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--proof-dim, #a8a8a2); } .ds-select-wrap { position: relative; width: fit-content; } .ds-select { height: 44px; min-width: 176px; padding: 0 40px 0 12px; appearance: none; background: var(--sheet-raised, #1b1b1b); border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #43433f); border-radius: 0; color: var(--proof, #e6e6e3); font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; } .ds-select:hover { border-color: var(--proof-dim, #a8a8a2); } .ds-select:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--grease, #e0352b); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-chevron { position: absolute; right: 12px; top: 50%; width: 16px; height: 16px; transform: translateY(-50%); color: var(--proof-dim, #a8a8a2); pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Example Brief
components.description: A frame label on the slate: top hairline, amber edge-print label, dim brief text; hover inks it to full amber.
components.css: .ds-example { display: flex; flex-direction: column; max-width: 420px; padding: 12px 0 0; text-align: left; background: transparent; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #2b2b2a); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-example-label { font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-transform: uppercase; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--edge, #f2c21b) 80%, transparent); } .ds-example-text { margin-top: 6px; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.375; color: var(--proof-dim, #a8a8a2); } .ds-example:hover { border-top-color: var(--edge, #f2c21b); } .ds-example:hover .ds-example-label { color: var(--edge, #f2c21b); } .ds-example:hover .ds-example-text { color: var(--proof, #e6e6e3); } .ds-example:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--grease, #e0352b); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Film Frame
components.description: Signature: a black film border around a square image well, with amber edge print (frame number, days live) beneath.
components.css: .ds-frame { width: 220px; padding: 10px; background: var(--film, #050505); border-radius: 0; } .ds-frame-well { aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; background: #2c4f7c; } .ds-frame-edge { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; margin: 8px 0 0; font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-transform: uppercase; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--edge, #f2c21b); }

components.name: Grease Mark
components.description: Signature: a wobbly two-pass loop through the wax filter around a pick, with its rank written in Permanent Marker.
components.html: 1
components.css: .ds-mark { position: relative; width: 200px; height: 200px; margin: 32px; } .ds-mark-frame { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--film, #050505); } .ds-mark-loop { position: absolute; inset: -12px; width: calc(100% + 24px); height: calc(100% + 24px); overflow: visible; pointer-events: none; } .ds-loop { stroke-dasharray: 1; stroke-dashoffset: 1; animation: ds-mark 520ms cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1) 200ms forwards; } .ds-rank { position: absolute; left: -12px; top: -28px; font-family: 'Permanent Marker', cursive; font-size: 40px; line-height: 1; color: var(--grease, #e0352b); transform: rotate(-6deg); animation: ds-write 280ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 580ms both; } @keyframes ds-mark { to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; } } @keyframes ds-write { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(4px) rotate(-8deg) scale(0.9); } to { opacity: 1; transform: rotate(-6deg); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-loop { animation: none; stroke-dashoffset: 0; } .ds-rank { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
Picking references is a picture edit. The interface is a darkroom proof sheet: a charcoal ground, each ad held in a black film frame with edge print running beneath it, and a single grease-pencil red that is the editor's hand. The reranker's picks are not badged or highlighted; they are circled, wobbly and waxy, and numbered in marker in the order they were chosen. Everything else stays quiet so the ads, which are the content, carry the colour.

Density is that of a working sheet, not a dashboard: one slate for the brief, one row of controls in edge print, then a strip of five equal frames at desktop width. Structure comes from hairline rules and the black of the film, never from cards, fills, or elevation. The system is dark only; it is built to read on a screen share.
keyCharacteristics: Charcoal sheet, black film frames, hairline rules; square corners everywhere.
Amber edge print (narrow tracked caps) for metadata, labels and frame numbers.
Grease-pencil red is the only mark: picks, rank numerals, focus, the primary action, the caret, selection.
Hand-drawn marks are real geometry with an SVG wax filter, never a raster or an icon.
Motion is photographic: frames develop, then the pencil circles them in rank order.

rules.name: The One Mark Rule
rules.body: Grease red means "chosen" or "act here". It never decorates, never fills a panel, and never appears as a second accent next to another mark colour.

rules.name: The Ink Split Rule
rules.body: Amber informs, red judges. Metadata and labels are amber or grey; anything that ranks, selects, or commits is red.

rules.name: The Marker Is Only For Ranks Rule
rules.body: Permanent Marker appears only as the handwritten rank numeral. It is never used for words, headings, or buttons.

rules.name: The Edge Print Rule
rules.body: Metadata speaks in edge print: Archivo Narrow, uppercase, 0.09em tracking. Reading text never does.

rules.name: The No-Lift Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. Separation comes from film black, hairlines, and scale, never from a cast shadow.

dos: Do hold every ad in a black film frame with edge print beneath it.
Do keep grease red for marks, focus, and the single primary action.
Do set all metadata, labels and status lines in edge print (Archivo Narrow 600, 0.75rem, 0.09em, uppercase).
Do draw hand marks as SVG paths through the `#wax` filter, in rank order, and make them instant under reduced motion.
Do separate regions with hairlines (`rule`, `rule-strong`) and space, keeping corners square.
Do label proxies as proxies in amber edge print beside the number they qualify.
donts: Don't use rounded cards, box shadows, or gradients.
Don't introduce a second accent colour; amber and red are the only inks.
Don't use Permanent Marker for anything but rank numerals.
Don't fake the pencil with raster textures, emoji, or icon-font glyphs.
Don't add a light theme; the sheet is dark only.
